A '''collar box''' (or '''director unit''') was a handheld circuitry box linked to the [[Shock collar/Legends|collars]] on a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver's]] line. The collars were connected by a thin cable, which could energize the collars to subdue unruly or defiant slaves. The directors were banned devices in most societies, and were often homemade, with an unfinished look.
